summary: Frontend adds Windows Aero-style CSS utilities, Start gating via sessionStorage, and rich-media paste utilities. However, backend clue model/APIs remain Text-by-Nat without slug/title/content, no migration is shown, and frontend routing/loading still depends on numeric IDs, so slug-based clues and titles are not actually supported end-to-end.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend clue data model and APIs must support slug + title + rich content, provide create/fetch-by-slug/list-in-stable-order, and keep numeric URLs working via slugs like "1".
missing_requirements.reason: Diff shows backend still stores/returns clues as plain Text indexed by Nat (createClue(Text), getClue(Nat)->Text, listClues()->[Text]) with no slug/title/content record type and no get-by-slug API.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add conditional state migration preserving existing Text-per-Nat clues into the new clue record format with deterministic slugs ("1", "2", ...) and non-empty titles (e.g., "Clue #1").
missing_requirements.reason: No migration file or migration logic is shown; backend remains on the old Text clue format, so there is nothing converting existing state to the new structure.

missing_requirements.requirement: Frontend routing and clue loading must use the slug after /echofields/ and fetch the clue by slug; nonexistent slugs show "Clue Not Found" without crashing.
missing_requirements.reason: CluePage still parses the route param as a number and calls useGetClue with a BigInt numeric ID; if the param is non-numeric it immediately renders "Clue Not Found" rather than fetching by slug.

missing_requirements.requirement: Display each clue’s title on the clue page and in relevant lists/labels (admin list shows title alongside slug/path).
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend clue fetch returns only Text content (per backend), so CluePage sets title as "Clue #..." and cannot display a stored clue title; admin list/title+slug display is not evidenced and backend listClues returns [Text] only.

missing_requirements.requirement: Start gating must only block the first clue determined by stable clue order (not hardcoded), allow unlock per session, and not block non-first clues.
missing_requirements.reason: Start gating is hardcoded to treat clueId === '1' as the first clue; there is no evidence it derives the first clue from a stable ordered clue list/first element as required once slugs are introduced.

missing_requirements.requirement: For clues after the first, allow entering just the next slug and navigate to /echofields/{slug}; support full internal paths; external URLs still open safely in a new tab per existing safety rules.
missing_requirements.reason: CluePage navigates using the entered value as the route param, but clue loading still requires a numeric ID (parseInt + useGetClue(BigInt)), so entering a non-numeric slug cannot actually load a clue. No evidence is shown that full internal paths are normalized/handled or that external URLs are still validated/opened per safeUrl rules in this input flow.

missing_requirements.requirement: Admin create-clue workflow must create a clue tied to slug + title + content (with client-side validation and slug preview).
missing_requirements.reason: AdminPage collects title/slug/content and validates them, but the create call still sends only content to the backend (`mutateAsync(newClueContent)`) and explicitly notes "until backend supports structured clues"; thus it does not actually create slug+title+content clues.
